page.emptyBody: Astro-Vastu maps your natal planetary positions across the 16 cosmic directions of your living space using Mahavastu principles. We need your birth details to generate your personalized spatial analysis.
page.requires: Requires date, time, and place of birth for accurate analysis
page.footerBody: Astro-Vastu bridges the micro-cosmos (your horoscope) and the macro-cosmos (your environment). By balancing the Pancha Bhutas based on your strongest and weakest planets, you create a resonance that amplifies prosperity and well-being. The 45 Devatas of the Vastu Purusha Mandala represent specific psychographic energies that can be harmonized through conscious spatial design.

home.title: My Home — room mapper
home.subtitle: Mark the zone of each room in your home (from the centre of the house). Each placement is checked against Vastu rules and against how strong that zone is in your chart. Saved only in this browser.
home.legend: A dashed green outline marks the best zone for each room. A room can sit in more than one zone.

home.findingsTitle: {count, plural, one {# placement needs attention} other {# placements need attention}}
home.allGood: Every placement fits Vastu and your chart

advice.high: Classical Vastu advises against a {room} in the {zone}. Best zone: {best}. If moving it is not possible, keep this area clean and light and use the remedies for this zone.
advice.medium: Acceptable placement, but {zone} is weak in your chart ({score}%). Keep it uncluttered and add the zone's element remedy.
advice.low: Right place, but {zone} is weak in your chart ({score}%). Support this zone with its remedy to get the full benefit.
advice.neutral: Acceptable placement. The ideal zone for a {room} is {best}.

dashaFocus.title: Your Vastu focus now

ayadi.title: Ayadi — building size check
ayadi.subtitle: Classical Ayadi Shadvarga (Mayamata, Manasara) tests a building's length and breadth for income, expenditure, yoni, nakshatra, weekday and tithi, and matches the nakshatra to your birth star.
ayadi.empty: Enter the length and breadth of the house or plot to check it.
ayadi.suggest: Nearest better size: {length} × {breadth} ft passes {passed} of {total} checks.
ayadi.note: Uses the area method in feet (A = length × breadth). Schools differ in unit and multipliers, so confirm the final size with your Vastu consultant before building.
ayadi.noteMetres: Metres are converted to feet for the area method. Size suggestions appear only in feet. Schools differ, so confirm with your Vastu consultant before building.

live.title: Live compass
live.subtitle: Hold your phone flat and point its top edge at a wall or doorway. The dial shows which zone you are facing and how strong it is in your chart.
live.denied: Motion access was not allowed. Allow it in your browser settings, or use the slider below.
live.unsupported: This device has no compass reading in the browser. Use the slider below, or open this page on your phone.
live.manual: Or turn the dial by hand
live.note: Stand near the centre of the room, away from metal and electronics, and move the phone in a figure-8 once to calibrate. Phone compasses can be off by a few degrees.

tip.strong: A strong zone for you. Good for a work desk, important papers or time spent here.
tip.mid: An average zone. Keep it tidy, light and uncluttered.
tip.weak: A weak zone in your chart. Avoid clutter and heavy objects here, and see the Remedies tab.

tracker.title: Vastu remedy tracker
tracker.subtitle: Pick a zone and do its short daily practice for 21 or 40 days. Your weakest zones in the chart are suggested first. Tick each day as you finish it.

tracker.todayOpen: Today is open. Tick it when you finish.
tracker.missed: A day was missed. Restart to begin a fresh run.
tracker.rules: Only today can be ticked, and days follow your time zone. Missing a day ends the run, as with traditional sadhana. Saved to your account.

muhurta.rules: Traditionally fixed nakshatras (Rohini, the three Uttaras), a waxing Moon and weekdays other than Tuesday are preferred, and Rikta tithis and Amavasya are avoided. The search scores these limbs and your personal tara for you.

bhavas.coreTitle: Core Principle of Vedic Astro Vastu
bhavas.coreBody: Astro Vastu integrates the principles of Vastu Shastra with insights from Jyotish (Vedic Astrology). The goal is to enhance positive energy and overall well-being by aligning living spaces with both Vastu directional principles and the individual's astrological chart. By mapping planetary influences to spatial zones, we create environments that resonate with each person's unique cosmic blueprint — facilitating smoother energy flow, enhancing positive outcomes, and mitigating adverse influences.
bhavas.coreByline: — Classical Vedic synthesis: Jyotish Shastra × Vastu Shastra

actions.p2detail: Puja room or sacred corner in NE. Remove all clutter and toilet from this zone. Light ghee lamp daily.
actions.p3detail: Master bedroom in SW with head facing South. Heavy wardrobes in SW corner. No cuts or missing corners in SW.
actions.p4detail: Home office or work desk facing ENE or N. Professional awards in ENE zone. Sun yantra in East wall.
actions.p5detail: Kitchen stove in SE. Cooking facing East. Cash locker away from SW only if Rahu is difficult. Agni deepam in SE.
